content:
maria_re: Quick sync - SummitPay wants a gated POC. Must ensure: all customer data stays inside EU, BYOK (HSM) with customer key control, and explicit list of subprocessors. They also asked: can we guarantee regional-only control-plane telemetry?

Tom_presales: Short answers: yes to EU-only tenancy, yes to BYOK (we support common cloud HSMs), and we can provide subprocessors list & certs. Control-plane telemetry can be EU-only for pinned tenants. Need to confirm which regions they accept (we usually propose eu-west-1 primary + eu-central-1 standby).

josh_infra: Technical caveat: warm-standby across EU regions works. For near-zero RPO we need synchronous intra-EU replication. That increases latency/cost. If they require zero cross-border egress, ensure routing policy disallows any US endpoints and disable global telemetry flags.

nina_sec: I will compile subprocessors for the EU regions and attach SOC2/ISO excerpts. Also provide BYOK attestation template and guidance on KMS key residency.

maria_re: They also want pricing difference between pinned single-region vs pinned+warm-standby. Can someone give a ballpark?

Tom_presales: Typical ballpark: primary reserved capacity X, warm-standby uplift ~20-35% depending on scale; hot-active ~1.8-2.0x. I'll draft numbers and assumptions.

opsbot: Note: runbook template available at /docs/presales/runbooks/region-failover.md. Canary deploy available for eu-west-1.

josh_infra: For session stickiness use signed tokens and short TTLs; add header hint x-region-prefer for retries. Include runbook steps: failover trigger -> scale-up standby -> DNS flip -> health-check -> resume traffic.

maria_re: Action items: Nina -> subprocessors + attestation (today), Tom -> pricing + one-pager (EOD), Josh -> concise infra notes for runbook (tomorrow). I'll schedule a 30m tech sync once materials land.

(reacts: :white_check_mark: by tom_presales)
